source.title: Atlas des champignons comestibles et vénéneux (Planche 3)

sourceEvidence.role: warning-pattern limits; the plate is not sole evidence

modifications: Cropped one upright study from source region 1000x2300+150+300 and one angled study from source region 950x1700+1100+1300.
Excluded the plate title, species name, toxicity label, and unrelated specimens by cropping and painting only background regions white.
Converted to monochrome, resized both studies, recomposed them on a 1300x846 opaque-white canvas, normalized the paper white point, stripped metadata, and encoded as lossless WebP.
normalizationCommands: magick atlas-planche-03-original.jpg -crop 1000x2300+150+300 +repage -colorspace Gray -contrast-stretch 0.5%x0.5% -level 10%,90% -background white -alpha remove -alpha off amanita-vertical-crop.png

magick atlas-planche-03-original.jpg -crop 950x1700+1100+1300 +repage -fill white -draw 'rectangle 820,0 950,120' -colorspace Gray -contrast-stretch 0.5%x0.5% -level 10%,90% -background white -alpha remove -alpha off amanita-angled-crop.png

magick -size 1300x846 canvas:white ( amanita-vertical-crop.png -resize x760 ) -gravity west -geometry +150+0 -composite ( amanita-angled-crop.png -resize x750 ) -gravity east -geometry +120+0 -composite -fill white -draw 'rectangle 140,0 500,80' -draw 'rectangle 940,0 1190,110' -draw 'rectangle 455,390 700,760' -draw 'rectangle 440,760 700,846' -draw 'rectangle 755,75 790,120' -colorspace sRGB -strip -define webp:lossless=true amanita-warning-constellation.webp
assets.selectionRationale: Two views make the cap, gills, veil ring, and bulbous base legible at normal A5 scale in a historically compatible botanical style. Alt text and adjacent prose explicitly prevent the plate from being read as a death-cap portrait or identification key.

source.title: Atlas des champignons comestibles et vénéneux (Planche 78)
source.itemIdentity: Morchella conica and Gyromitra esculenta external forms

sourceEvidence.role: external morphology and safety constraints; internal anatomy remains source-backed text

modifications: Selected the pitted Morchella conica and brainlike Gyromitra esculenta external studies.
Excluded every historical name and edibility label; painted only unrelated background fragments and a scan speck white.
Converted to monochrome, recomposed with equal visual weight on an opaque-white 1869x842 canvas, stripped metadata, and encoded as lossless WebP.
normalizationCommands: magick atlas-planche-78-original.jpg -crop 650x1100+1550+200 +repage -colorspace Gray -level 10%,90% -background white -alpha remove -alpha off morel-true.png

magick atlas-planche-78-original.jpg -crop 1050x950+250+1850 +repage -fill white -draw 'rectangle 0,0 1050,130' -draw 'rectangle 180,820 410,950' -colorspace Gray -level 10%,90% -background white -alpha remove -alpha off morel-false.png

magick -size 1869x842 canvas:white ( morel-true.png -resize x720 ) -gravity west -geometry +160+0 -composite ( morel-false.png -resize x700 ) -gravity east -geometry +90+0 -composite -colorspace sRGB -strip -define webp:lossless=true morel-warning-comparison.webp
assets.selectionRationale: One coherent historical plate supplies visibly pitted and brainlike external forms. The image deliberately does not claim hollow-versus-chambered anatomy; those current safety claims remain in editable text backed by S09.
